Retire-Now Content

ContentsTopPrevious: At-Risk ContentNext: Replacement Suggestions

Rows with the strongest retirement signal. Higher retire score is worse. The Top 100 workshop and sprint tables below show 10 rows first and continue through filtering and pagination.

What Drives The Retire-Now Score

4 variables

Uses the same stored retire_score formula as At-Risk Content, but applies stricter rule gates.

40 * demand_pressure + 30 * staleness_score + 20 * replacement_support_score + 10 * no_owner_score

Higher is worse. Retire-Now rows are selected by score plus stricter gates, so they are the strongest retirement candidates, not just the highest raw scores.

Low Demand Score: 40%Staleness Score: 30%Replacement Support: 20%No Owner Score: 10%
demand_pressureMostly 12-month demand, with a smaller 90-day demand check so short-term drops also count.
staleness_scoreHow old the last meaningful content update is. Anything older than 12 months is stale.
replacement_support_scoreHow strong the replacement path is. Confirmed replacements count more than review-only replacements.
no_owner_scoreExtra pressure when nobody clearly owns the workshop.
  • Rows need low demand, stale content, enough age, and a valid replacement path.
  • Fallback tiers may be used if strict tiers do not fill the list.
  • Score alone is not enough; gate checks still apply.
